title: XCF (GIMP image) signature
summary: An XCF file begins with the 9-byte signature 'gimp xcf ' (0x67 0x69 0x6D 0x70 0x20 0x78 0x63 0x66 0x20) followed by the version string ('v001', 'v002', or 'v003').
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: XCF is GIMP's native image format (layers, channels, paths).
XCF supports RLE compression for layer data.
